definitions.supplemental: O. H. Ger. durh-porón perforare, terebrare.

quotations.old_english: Ðá wolde ic witan hwæðer ða gelícnissa wǽron gegotene ealle swá hé sǽde; hét hié ðá þurhborian
quotations.latin: simulacra quae an solida essent scire ego cupiens omnia perforavi

source_text: þurh-borian to bore through, perforate :-- Ðá wolde ic witan hwæðer ða gelícnissa wǽron gegotene ealle swá hé sǽde; hét hié ðá þurhborian simulacra quae an solida essent scire ego cupiens omnia perforavi, Nar. 20, 1. [O. H. Ger. durh-porón perforare, terebrare.]
